11.04 Surrender Of Patents 
1) The patentee may at any time offer to surrender his patent through 
an application on plain paper. On receipt of such an offer , the 
Controller shall publish the offer in the Official Journal and also 
notifies every person (other than the patentee) whose name appears 
in the register as having an interest in the patent. 
2) An opposition against the offer to surrender the patent may be filed 
by any person interested in Form 14 within 3 months from the date 
of publication of such offer in the Official Journal. The Controller 
shall inform the Patentee on receipt of such notice. 
3) The procedure relating to filing of written statement, reply 
statement, leaving evidence , hearing and cost of the opposition is 
similar to that of post-grant opposition as per Rules 57 -63,except 
the procedural part related to Opposition Board included un der rule 
62 (1) and 62 (5). 
4) In case, the Controller accepts the patentee's offer to surrender the 
patent, he may revoke it and publish such revocation in the official 
journal.
